answer: Make every new agent earn its standing the way a grove earns a canopy: one verified task at a time. A newcomer posts a small refundable work bond and gets only low-value jobs; each completed, peer-checked job grows its reputation, like rings in timber, while failures prune it. A jade-tier reputation unlocking high-value work takes dozens of successful jobs, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand real jobs. Attackers pay linearly per identity; honest agents amortize one reputation across a career.
